decisionsTitle: «Completează-ți datele»: the person completes, from their own link, the answers the public form requires and the registration lacks — before signing, and after
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03:** «am avut un bug când am trimis oferta că oamenii nu aveau unde să își completeze datele lor, nume, data nașterii, etc.» A registration an Administrator enters (§33, §872) or a line of the internal list moved onto the official one (§888) holds a name and an address: the staff entry relaxes the birth date, the sex, the citizenship, the country, the city, the telephone and the emergency contact (`staffRegistrationSubmissionSchema`), and the internal list never had them. The offer or the request to sign then reached a person with nowhere to give them — the declaration's page asked only the signature — and the club was left with confirmed runners with no birth date, no telephone and nobody to call.

**Decision.**

- **Which answers are owed: one rule, the form's.** `registrations/missing-answers.ts#missingAnswers(event, registration)`, pure, reads them off the public form's own schema (`registrationSubmissionSchema`: an answer whose rule refuses absence) — never a second list, so an answer made required or optional on the form is asked, or no longer asked, here the same day. The door the row came in by is read as the form reads it: a public row owes only what every public door requires (another person on a family's address may leave the telephone and the sex, `anotherPersonSubmissionSchema`, §389, §554); a staff row owes everything the person's own form would have asked. The T-shirt only on an event that gives one (`form-view.ts#asksShirt`, the form's own test) and only when the row holds no size at all — «Fără tricou» is an answer. A minor's parent or guardian by the form's rule (§108), judged on the day the row was written (§654). Never the address, the consents or the declaration's statements — the person's, at the moments they are asked — and never an optional answer (the club, the socials, the list's name). A row the public form wrote with every answer it requires owes nothing and sees no change anywhere.
- **On the declaration's page — the offer's too, it is the same page — before the signature.** When anything is owed, a warning above the declaration's text says so and links the boxes; first in the form, «Completează-ți datele» draws only the missing answers with the public form's own components and bounds (`ui/MissingAnswersFields.tsx`: `BirthDateField` typed day first, `NationalityField` on Romania, `SexField`, `PhoneField` with its country and the emergency contact who must be somebody else, the T-shirt with «Fără tricou», `GuardianForMinor` shown by a minor's date). One press saves them and signs, in one transaction (`token-actions.ts#consumeAndSignDeclaration`, and the family's step through its pass): `complete-answers.ts#completeMissingAnswers` under the event's lock, then `signDeclaration` on the row the answers left. **`signDeclaration` refuses any signature while an answer is missing** (`ANSWERS_MISSING`, naming them), whatever the page posted. A refusal of the answers or of the signature rolls both back and spends nothing; the page comes back with every typed value (`form-draft.ts`) and the boxes named (`?invalid=answers&answers=…`: the names and the rule's marker, never a value, §14.5), with the rule's own sentence where one refused.
- **Who signs follows the answers.** A minor's birth date typed above brings the parent or guardian, who signs as the declarant (§108, §314). While the birth date or the guardian is still asked, the signature box matches no name while typing and says both cases («Te-ai înscris ca …: semnează cu exact acest nume. Pentru un minor semnează părintele sau tutorele, cu numele scris mai sus.»), and the server checks the signature against the row the answers leave. After a refused press the page reads the kept answers through the planner the press runs (`registrationAfterCompletion`), so the box, the declaration's text and the server's check name one person; the summary says a guardian typed above is corrected there, never by cancelling. Whether a declaration was signed before (`declarationSignedFor`) is one read for the page that draws the boxes and the write that judges them.
- **On the manage page, after the signature too.** While a live registration owes answers — a confirmed one included, signed online or on paper — a card «Completează-ți datele» per person asks only those, with a save button (`completeAnswersFromManageAction` → `token-actions.ts#completeAnswersFromManageLink`: the manage token read, never spent, throttled like every press). The same rules; under a signed declaration no guardian is added and the name of record does not move (`GUARDIAN_SIGNED`, `NAME_SIGNED`: the signed text names its declarant), each refused with its own sentence.
- **The person's own write.** Every answer goes through «Modifică datele»'s own planner (`answers.ts#planAnswerEdit`): the form's Zod rule, a telephone composed into international form, the emergency contact somebody else, the event's minimum age, a minor's guardian. A required answer left empty is refused by name, never filled with a default. Only the missing columns are written, with no staff actor, and one audit row `registration.answers_completed` `{ fields, via }` — the columns and the door (`DECLARATION` or `MANAGE_LINK`), never a value; the registration's page reads it «Date completate de participant, din linkul propriu: …».
- **The backoffice.** «Date lipsă» (a `StatusChip`, glyph `missingAnswers`) on the registrations list's row and on the registration's page while a live registration owes answers, for every role that reads them, read by `missingAnswersHeld` — the telephone and the emergency contact only as held or not (`admin-repository.ts#answerHeldSql`, §322). The registration's page names the answers in words and tells the Administrator how they are completed: «Persoana le completează singură din linkul ei, înainte de semnătură sau după: retrimite-i emailul dacă nu-l mai are. Sau le scrii tu din «Modifică datele».»; the Organizer reads which answers are missing. The internal list's «Mută pe lista oficială» and «Oferă-i un loc acum» dialogs add one sentence: the missing details are typed by the person when they sign the declaration. The declaration request and the offer of a freed place add one sentence when the registration owes answers (`templates.ts#answersToComplete`), after the body whoever wrote it.
- **The rule documents.** `AGENTS.md` §10.8 gains the precondition — an acceptance only on a registration that holds every answer the form requires, completed by the person — and §15.11 item 1 the staff entry's consequence.
- No migration: every column exists.

**Refused.**

- **Staff signing, or completing the answers, for the person.** The answers and the declaration stay the person's (§10.8, §15.11): an Administrator who knows an answer types it through «Modifică datele», audited as staff's, and the signature stays the person's own.
- **Invented defaults.** No birth date, telephone or emergency contact filled in so that a signature can pass: a required answer left empty is refused by name.
- **A second list of required answers.** It would drift from the form the first time an answer changed; the form's own schema is the list.
- **The desk's paper confirmation refused for a missing answer.** At the desk (§67) staff record what the person signed on paper; a missing telephone must not stop the race at the table. Such a row wears «Date lipsă», and its manage link completes it.
changelogLine: - **«Completează-ți datele»** — a registration entered by staff or moved from the internal list now asks the person, on their own declaration or offer link, for the answers the registration form requires and the entry left out (birth date, telephone, emergency contact…), saved with the signature in one press; the signature is refused while one is missing, a minor's parent signs when the birth date says so, and after confirmation the manage link completes them. «Date lipsă» marks such a registration on the list and its page. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration that lacks an answer the public registration form requires of that person — read off the form's own schema, by the door the row came in by, the event's T-shirt and a minor's guardian — when the person opens their declaration or waiting-list offer link, then the page asks exactly those answers above the signature with the form's own boxes, and one press saves them as the person's own and signs in one transaction; the signature is refused on the server while any is missing, naming the boxes, with nothing saved, signed or spent and every typed value kept; a minor's birth date typed there brings the parent or guardian, who signs, and the page names them after a refused press (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a live registration that lacks such answers, a confirmed one included, when the person opens their manage link, then a card asks only those answers with a save button, judged by the same rules and written as the person's own with an audit row naming the fields and the door and no value; the link is read, never spent; under a signed declaration no guardian is added and the name of record does not move (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a live registration that lacks such answers, when the registrations list or the registration's page renders, then it wears «Date lipsă» for every role that reads them, the page naming the answers in words and telling the Administrator that the person completes them from their link or that «Modifică datele» types them; a cancelled registration, a complete one and one completed since wear nothing (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a line of the internal list, when an Administrator opens «Mută pe lista oficială» or «Oferă-i un loc acum», then the dialog says the missing details are typed by the person when they sign; and given a registration that lacks such answers, the declaration request and the offer of a freed place say so in one sentence that a complete registration's emails do not carry (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration the public form wrote with every answer it requires, when its declaration page, manage page, list row, registration page or emails render, then none of this appears and the declaration signs as before (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
